review.coverage: 158 tests, 123 distinct n spanning 1..1e6, every n mod 6 residue, n=1,2,3 and n=1e6; 87 official rows equal pinned row.
review.incorrectAreAlgorithmic: Every incorrect source read in full; each prints a numerically wrong single answer on at least one valid test (not just formatting/debug output).
review.independentOracle: n<=2: n; odd: n(n-1)(n-2); even and n%3: n(n-1)(n-3); else (n-1)(n-2)(n-3); cross-checked against exhaustive triple LCM for n=1..60.
review.officialTests: official_tests_complete; every official pinned-row pair present in package (inputs equal after CRLF normalization, outputs token-equal); source row byte-equal to independently downloaded, hash-verified pinned open-r1/codeforces parquet row.
review.oracleResult: All 158 package tests and all samples pass strict format/range parse; every expected output equals my oracle; all official upstream rows also equal my oracle.
review.sandbox: Own harness (sha256 c582ff42...983d0d, not worker pool_harness): pinned python@sha256:5887f265...05d3, --network=none, --read-only, --user=65534, --cap-drop=ALL, no-new-privileges, pids<=32, 1 CPU, 2560m memory, RLIMIT_CPU/AS at problem limits, bounded output, launched from env -i shell without credentials; re-run against the normalized-six archive bytes.
review.singleAnswer: Output is one integer uniquely determined by the input; token comparison is correct, no special checker, no float tolerance.
review.statement: Packaged bound "1 ≤ n ≤ 10<sup>6</sup>"; original "106" preserved in statement-sources/235A.original.html (one-line diff); attested Luogu CF235A original English; re-fetched independently.
review.submissionProvenance: All 10 sources byte-identical (sha256) to rows in pinned open-r1/codeforces-submissions shards (shard sha256 verified independently); evidence sourceHash equals sha256 of those bytes.

n(n-1)(n-2)/gcd; for even n ignores n(n-1)(n-3) and (n-1)(n-2)(n-3)
always n(n-1)(n-2); wrong for every even n>=4
lcm(n,n-1,n-2) only; wrong for even n where n(n-1)(n-3) or (n-1)(n-2)(n-3) is larger
